content.text:
All eighteen playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations redlined (7):**
- **LOL-CAP** (critical): one-month fee cap "without exception" — raised to greater of 12 months' Fees / USD 1M and aligned with the Excluded Claims regime already in 21.3.
- **INDEMN** (critical): no Vendor indemnity at all, only an unlimited Customer indemnity (and a broken cross-ref to a non-existent "Section 20.5") — added Vendor IP/law/data-breach/misconduct indemnity, narrowed ours.
- **NONCOMPETE** (high): 24-month worldwide non-compete on us in 12.4 — deleted (contradicts 12.3).
- **EXCLUSIVITY** (high): full-term sole-provider obligation in 2.2 — deleted (contradicts 12.3).
- **LICENSE** (high): 13.1 licence revocable at Vendor's discretion, Affiliates/contractors excluded — extended and revocation tied to 13.3.
- **MINCOMMIT** (medium): three-year USD 6M take-or-pay with no exit — narrowed to 12 months, reducible, true-up.
- **WARRANTY** (medium): 15-day Deliverable warranty with remedy cut-off — extended to 90 days, 19.4 remedies preserved.
- **TRANSITION** (medium): 11.1 immediate deletion with no export — replaced with six months' transition assistance.

**Compliant (10):** MFN, NOSOLICIT, T4C, RENEWAL, GOVLAW, ASSIGN, IP, AUDIT, LD, INSURANCE.

Note for negotiation: several deviations (2.1, 2.2, 12.4, 13.1, 19.2, 11.1, 21.1) read as inserted overlays that directly contradict the surrounding drafting (12.3, 9.4, 13.2/13.3, 11.2/11.3, 21.3) — worth raising with Vendor as a single consistency point.
